caption.text:
Kelangkaan solar bersubsidi di Palembang dan Medan menyebabkan antrean panjang hingga berjam-jam, memicu korban jiwa, kerugian ekonomi, dan dugaan mafia distribusi, dengan kesenjangan besar antara permintaan dan realisasi kuota sebagai akar masalah.Seorang sopir truk berusia 50 tahun ditemukan meninggal akibat kelelahan saat mengantre solar di Banyuasin, Sumatra Selatan.

Selain itu, Kelangkaan BBM jenis Pertalite di sejumlah SPBU Kota Medan memaksa warga mengantre hingga dini hari untuk membeli Pertamax dengan harga lebih mahal.

Source🔎: Detik dan BBC
Source📹: @lensacinematic.sumut 

#BelacanCretivox #VoiceofPeople
caption.text_translation:
The shortage of subsidized solar in Palembang and Medan caused long queues for hours, triggering casualties, economic losses, and suspected distribution mafia, with a huge gap between demand and quota realization as the root of the problem.A 50-year-old truck driver was found dead of exhaustion while queuing for solar in Banyuasin, South Sumatra.

Besides, the scarcity of Pertalite petrol in some gas stations of Medan City forces citizens to queue up until early morning to buy Pertamax at a more expensive price.

Source🔎: Seconds and BBC
 Source📹: @lensacinematic.sumut 

 #BelacanCretivox #VoiceofPeople
